card.name: Date labels before a date
card.fires_on: Label words in page metadata that come right before a date or year, such as Last Updated, Review Date, Publication Year, Build date. It fires on the label word or colon just ahead of the date.

modes.label: Updated/Date labels
modes.description: The word Updated, updated or Date in a last-updated or posted-date line.

modes.label: Publication info labels
modes.description: Labels such as Year or Publication in book or paper details before a year.

modes.label: Colon after date label
modes.description: The colon or space right after a date label, just before the date itself.

card.writes: It seems to push the model toward code-like or odd tokens, with no clear link to dates.
card.plain: It lights up on labels like "Last updated" or "Publication Year" that are about to be followed by a date.
